notes.title: 1.24 hotfix
notes.notes:
We ran into an issue with pivots on the latest release and picked that opportunity to improve a few things!changes:pivots are fully working again
you can no longer pivot during a powerup sequence with no character movement
the keys to cycle through outfits are now E & T
(to avoid conflict with the default steam overlay shortcut)
the maximum ranked score was lifted
(as players are matched by division and score inflation has effectively been slowed down)

notes.title: New update, ranked season and DLC outfit go live this weekend
notes.notes:
Heads UP!

The new update, ranked season and DLC outfit will go live on Sunday after the anniversary tournament. https://steamcommunity.com/games/553310/announcements/detail/2899713886456550640
The update brings several gameplay changes and fixes based on the feedback survey.
First and foremost improvements to Dust & Ashes' special:it is overall easier to control
it is faster on the ground
and it has more options from the air
On top of that, ground and wall movement has been improved for all characters.

You can get a head start on the new ranked season by playing in the beta. Your achieved division will carry over into the live build. (you may need to join our discord to meet up with other players for that)

For a more detailed change list, see the BETA announcement: https://steamcommunity.com/games/553310/announcements/detail/2899713886456543926
On Friday we will reveal the lore and identity of the DLC outfit for Latch in our discord. Be there if you want to know who or what that mysterious figure in the beta outfit showcase is!

notes.title: Soundtrack & Outfits Bundle Update
notes.notes:
Finally releasing the Doombox outfits individually last week was a bit of a bumpy ride!

Turns out granting the Doombox DLC to all existing Soundtrack owners made it impossible to purchase the new bundle (or the Soundtrack, when owning Doombox first).

To resolve this we removed Doombox as a bonus outfit from the Soundtrack, but everyone who purchased it before today still owns the outfit individually.

If you had any trouble completing this new bundle before, it works now!

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/16023/Soundtrack__Outfits_Bundle/

notes.title: Medical Mashup Update releases on June 19
notes.notes:
Here is a refresher of everything to look forward to when the Medical Mashup hits next week!


The DLC

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33025459/910c374bfd8189f9ee56abfdc19828df56b860b8.png


Already promised away as a prize to the top 3 of the first Quarantined Rapport (the largest global Lethal League tournament to date!), the two Toxic DLC outfits will become available for purchase.
The Nuclear Nourishment colorway. A dark nurse themed outfit with a biohazard spinal fluid injection arm.
The N. N. Second Opinion colorway. A cute twist on the Nuclear Nourishment outfit, but the needles go just as deep.

The two winners of the North American and European Quarantined Rapport tournament today will receive this on top of their cash prize.

https://steamcommunity.com/games/553310/announcements/detail/2234295625136848743

The Changelist

Characters
 Grid bunts out of special again
 Candyman's special meter maxes out at 1 during a candy chain
 Candyballs now match the Candyman outfit
 Jet can hover with taunt at any jump height

Options
 New competitive mode in private lobbies using default 1 on 1 options
 New HP options (off, 50%, 75%, 100%, 125%, 150%, 175%, 200%)
 New powerup option to select an individual powerup to play with
 New video option to stop camera movement

Stages
 The pyrotechnics have moved further away from the Paradise Field stadium cage
 All the Retro stages are available online
 The Retro stages after City Streets are easier to unlock
 New random retro stage option to unlock
 All visual issues on Retro stages are fixed
 Retro stages only appear in competitive or ranked, if both players select one

Ranked Season 4

With the release of this update we are also moving into a new ranked season. The feedback for the season 3 progression has been overall positive with a single issue: The most dedicated players have all maxed out by now. That means they haven't just reached the highest 3 star first division, but the absolute maximum ranking score! To account for that the next season will have a much sharper ramp for the highest divisions and we may start to swap into new seasons more frequently outside of game updates.

notes.title: The Nintendo Switch patch goes live on October 16!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33025459/1320f07777dc961a6e34b6551bbfd2bb28551cc5.png

We have reworked all character models and stages, tweaked visuals and drove over the code with a bulldozer a couple of times to vastly improve performance on Nintendo Switch in both docked and handheld mode. A 1v1 matchmaking mode is added for the competitively minded among a myriad of other fixes. Here’s the full list: Improved performance
 Added 1v1 online mode
 Fixed certain un-unlockable outfits
 Fixed memory leaks
 Higher resolution for docked mode
 Correct system language on first start
 Character model fixes
 Fixed unnecessary server logouts

Tokyo Game Show trip
Part of the team just returned from a trip to Japan. Showing Blaze at Tokyo Game Show and being there while the boxed version released in stores was a blast! Turns out that the Japanese fans are just as hyped up as the fans from everywhere else. The team got showered with gifts, hosted a tournament at the Dutch Embassy, did interviews and had an idol group play our game (peak Japanese right there). We even bought our own game too!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33025459/e4fe0156c3b288943554c0c0e9118ef335e4d95b.jpg

Physical releases are still pretty relevant in the land of the rising sun and Dion has never hidden the fact that he gets a lot of inspiration from Japanese creators. For these reasons it made sense to do a Japan-exclusive special edition for Switch and PS4. However, since the language can be switched ingame and they’re both region free, you can still buy the box from abroad, get the goodies and play it as you would normally. It contains the game, a sticker, an artbooklet and a little Candyman keychain. I’d say it’s a must for collectors.

The Shadow Surge
This other upcoming uptown update will bring along the optimizations from the Nintendo Switch patch WITH of course the boyest of boys, Dust & Ashes. They will, like the rest of the cast, have alternate outfits to unlock and we’re happy to tease one of them today!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33025459/e23fcd2c6a27b35936213182d3dddda39f7ee3e2.png

notes.title: Update 1.07 Live
notes.notes:
That's right we jumped straight to 1.07.

The most important fix is the one with Quickmatch where some players needed to wait a lot longer while there were people readily available. Also the missing Frank Klepacki track in Showcase (sorry Frank!) and tons of small stuff in the visuals and gameplay. Scroll down past all the brabble to see the changes in detail!

Even though Ranked mode was a bonus that we didn't exactly plan to have on launch, we're very happy how avidly the mode is played (the please-take-a-break-for-your-health kind of avidly). I'm sure everyone is aware that Ranked mode will evolve over time, but thanks again for your patience.

Another thing of note is that modding is blowing up, with a big load of texture mods leading the way. Head over to #modding in the official Discord (discord.gg/reptilehideout) to learn how to do it too. Here's a showcase of some gems already:

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33025459/035a9c461406d631854f4d05b1567aa0547055a5.png

Then there's a Blaze tournament coming or should I say 'Doom Is Coming'... This Saturday on the 3rd of November all bets are off for this Lethal League Blaze tourney handled by your local Hangboy at 3PM EDT sharp on the official Discord in #competitive (discord.gg/reptilehideout).  

There's Megabyte Punch Steam keys to be won! Take a look at the rest of the rules over here:
https://challonge.com/DoomComing
Note that Beta testers from pre-release are not allowed to join this tournament.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33025459/aa735e484a0fb549130e07f8a5ba10573187f16c.png

Patch notes 1.07

General
- Fixed crash when username contains } {
- Fixed various texts and dialog
- Fixed some 2D effects (thanks Dr. Melkpak)
- Fixed a few causes of softlocks
- 'Couldn't join' message now includes reason why
- Player names do not disappear anymore when russian or japanese are the selected language
- Quickmatch matches quicker
- Fixed the back end of the Workbot Factory assembly line
- Added missing Jawbreaker to credits

Gameplay
- Changed Nitro's special return swing hitpause from a half-shorten to a full shorten
- Changed Grid's special reactivation margins and made the spike option only straight down
- Nitro special pre-charge shorten should be fixed
- Grid can no longer bunt out of special (will probably get something in return later)
- Latch regains doublejump on bunt from wall, but can't instantly bunt from wall anymore
- Added a late turn option to first few frames of grounded swings
- Later story events will use 5 stocks again (as intended)

Unlocks
- Changed the unlocking of outfits in the story mode to finishing the event without losing stocks. This goes for all outfits that had a story event requirement and removes their arcade mode requirement.
- Added the missing Frank Klepacki - Decible to Beats unlocks in Showcase
- Fixed the Vicious Volley achievement
- Fixed double unlock that caused negative Sparks
